wordmark.purpose: Coresample in the rail; display size ranked by uppercase and tracking.

title.purpose: Icicle cell names, segment options, rail links, stepper controls.

body.purpose: Prose, readout, notes, table cells; tabular numerals throughout.

label.purpose: Section band headings, legends, rail group labels, icicle level names; uppercase.

label-dense.purpose: Table heads and fact labels; uppercase.

mono.purpose: Addresses, instruction text, encodings, axis, numeric columns only.

shadows.name: focus-on-selected
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow: marks keyboard focus on an already selected icicle cell, alongside the outer focus ring. Not elevation.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Keyboard focus everywhere outside the rail; ink in light, amber in dark. Table rows use offset -2px and switch to on-sel when selected.

focus.name: focus-ring-rail
focus.purpose: Keyboard focus on the green rail, in both schemes.

extensions.motionNote: No transitions or animations. State changes are immediate; the timeline cursor redraws on pointer and arrow-key movement.

breakpoints.name: stack-card
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: rail 220px, selection card drops under the main column.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: single column, rail unstuck, nav and note hidden, 16px gutter, facts 2x2, timeline 180px, image stepper shown.

extensions.colorScheme: Dark values (-dark tokens) apply under prefers-color-scheme: dark; there is no manual theme toggle.

narrative.overview:
The inspector is the RISC-V green reference card made into a working screen. A run's cycle accounting is set the way the card sets an instruction set: pale green card stock, a dark green shell, reversed green bands for headings, black ink, and ruled tables in a muted green. Hierarchy comes from what a printed card has to hand: weight, case, reversal and rule. There are two type sizes and no third.

The density is a reference sheet's. Every surface is a table, a ruled row of proportional cells, or a figure with its label, and every figure is an exact count in tabular numerals. Colour beyond the greens is reserved for one meaning: why a cycle was lost. Red marks a taken-branch flush, amber a load-use stall, violet a jump. Nothing else on the page is red, amber or violet.

The build is flat, square-cornered and still. It has no shadows, no radius and no motion. Selection is shown by reversal into the shell green, and keyboard focus by a separate ring that is never the selection colour. The direction contract rejects two looks outright: a profiler's dark flame graph and a dashboard of hero numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Pale green stock ground, dark green rail and reversed section bands, black ink, muted green rules.
Two type sizes (13px and 24px); rank set by weight, case, reversal and rule.
Archivo and Archivo Narrow for words, JetBrains Mono for addresses, encodings and counts.
Cause colours (red, amber, violet) only for lost cycles, each with a darker text partner.
Selection reverses into green; focus is a separate ring drawn outside the element.
Flat and square: no shadows, no radius, no transitions.
A dark scheme that follows `prefers-color-scheme`, keeping every role.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Structure has one colour. Shell, bands, heavy rules, cell borders and selection all use the same green; never introduce a second structural hue.

rules.name: The Cause Colour Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and violet mean lost cycles and nothing else. They appear as stripes, segments, swatches and cause marks; as text they always switch to their -ink partner. Never use them for emphasis, status or decoration.

rules.name: The Focus Is Not Selection Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is never the selection colour: ink in light, amber in dark and in the rail. It is drawn outside the element (2px, offset 2px) so it stays visible against a reversed selected cell; a focused selected cell also gets an inset 2px ring in on-sel.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Only 13px and 24px exist. Rank comes from weight (400, 600, 700, 800), case, reversal into green and rule weight, never from a third size.

rules.name: The Whole Count Rule
rules.body: A count is never truncated. When a cell's count line does not fit, the line is hidden whole; the full figure stays in the cell's tooltip and in the selection card.

rules.name: The Mono For Figures Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for addresses, encodings and counts only, right-aligned and unwrapped in numeric columns. Words are never set in mono.

rules.name: The Proportional Cell Rule
rules.body: A cell's width is its share of cycles, always. A cell too narrow for text keeps its width and loses its text, never the reverse.

rules.name: The Printed Card Rule
rules.body: If a printed reference card could not do it, the screen does not: hierarchy is reversal, rule weight and tone, never shadow or lift.

dos: Do rank with weight, case, reversal and rule at 13px and 24px only.
Do put every section heading in a reversed green band (5px 10px, label type).
Do reverse selection into green (sel and on-sel) and keep focus a separate ring: ink in light, amber in dark and in the rail, drawn outside the element.
Do mark lost cycles with a swatch plus an abbreviation (br, lu, jp) in the cause's -ink text colour.
Do set counts, addresses and encodings in JetBrains Mono, right-aligned, with tabular numerals.
Do hide a count line that does not fit and keep the full figure in the tooltip and the card.
Do size proportional cells by cycles, and drop text, not width, when a cell gets thin.
Do keep the band to two lines: scope in narrow caps, then figure plus unit.
donts: Don't look like a profiler's dark flame graph or a dashboard of hero numbers.
Don't add a third type size.
Don't use red, amber or violet for anything but lost cycles, or set cause text in the swatch colour.
Don't make the focus ring the selection colour.
Don't truncate or ellipsize a count.
Don't round corners, add shadows or animate state changes.
